correctness.rationale: EF three-round equivalence reduces to uniform first-vertex pair profiles of third-vertex equality/adjacency patterns. For r=(v-1)/(k-1), distinct adjacent flags share r-2 or k-2 common neighbors; nonadjacent flags share at most one and both types occur. All remaining single-vertex patterns are available (for k>=3 the inequality vr>2(r+k-1); for k=2,v>=4 similarly); C6 boundary handled separately. This proves profile uniformity for every design, not just enumerated examples. Two explicit rank3 triangle/edge-without-common-neighbor sentences separate rows. r>=k for k>=3 gives minimum vr=21, Fano witnesses equality; other minima 6,12. J(7,3) has same extension profile and an induced claw certifies rank4 separation from all line graphs. Independently constructed pair-type enumerator for pair designs v=3,4,5, Fano, J(7,3) and reproduced equivalences, without treating samples as general proof.

value.rationale: A complete shallow model-theoretic classification of the natural flag line graph for every finite Steiner 2-design, not an arbitrary specific example. It shows exact insensitivity to design isomorphism, sharp smallest representatives, and a structurally striking Johnson-graph equivalence followed by one-rank separation. The result is usable as a low-quantifier distinguishing bound in incidence structures.
